name: GlitchVoltx-editor
description: This is an open source website editor by Glitchvoltx. 100% Free no limits. In beta

paragraphs: The Free, Open-Source Visual Website Builder with AI, 3D, Vector & Custom Animations

GlitchVoltx Editor (v3 Beta) is a production-ready visual website builder that combines our proprietary custom animation engine, native vector graphics and animations, 3D Spline scenes, frame-by-frame image sequences, AI-powered features, and an intuitive drag-and-drop design interface—all in one free, open-source platform.
Built for creators, developers, sound artists, and designers who want professional-grade web design tools without monthly subscription fees.
features: 100% Free Forever – Use it directly in your browser or self-host without limits
Custom Animation Engine – Lightweight, native animation performance with built-in vector morphing built right in
Rich Media & Interactive Elements – Native support for Vector SVGs, Vector Animations, Image Sequences, customizable Video & Audio players, Lottie, Spline 3D scenes, Marquees, and Code Blocks
AI Integration – Smart features like automatic sitemap generation with Gemini AI
Variable System – Manage global design tokens, dynamic values, and consistent styling
